item.description: UPPER CAPE – YMCA Cape Cod has announced the official groundbreaking for the Don & Dottie Smith YMCA, moving the project toward bringing a cutting-edge YMCA to the Upper Cape one step closer to becoming a reality. item.title: Bourne Fire sets milestone having responded to most calls in a single year ever
item.description: BOURNE – From Bourne Fire: Overnight last night, Bourne Fire/Rescue surpassed 5,299 emergency calls for service in 2025. Once again, this makes 2025 the busiest year in our department’s history. This marks the fifth consecutive year of increased call volume, reflecting the growing needs of our community and the constant demand placed on our responders. item.title: Claims to be accepted on Nantucket related to wind turbine debris incident
item.description: NANTUCKET – The Town of Nantucket will begin accepting claims next month in connection to last summer’s Vineyard Wind turbine blade failure. The July 13th, 2024 incident scattered foam, fiberglass and other debris along Nantucket’s shores, as well as other parts of the Cape and Islands. item.description: BOSTON – Governor Maura Healey has announced critical support for thousands of health care workers in the form of a tax exemption for thousands of Personal Care Attendants, or PCAs.
